top_line_honesty_note: Track B reproduces ESTABLISHED DMVV/DMZ mathematics (Goettsche's Euler-number formula, the p_24(2)=324 polar multiplicity, the 648*Hhat identity). Agreement with known results validates that THIS COMPUTATIONAL LOOP is implemented correctly -- it is a check on the loop, not independent evidence for the dual-scale model. A second track re-deriving the same literature facts does not compound into stronger support for the theory.
strongest_evidence: The single most convincing rigidity result is the negative control in part 2: perturbing a K3 elliptic-genus Fourier coefficient c(3) or c(4) BY +1 (an input, not a prefactor we inserted) breaks the identity 4*G_2=9*B^2+3*E4*A^2 at 122 of the checked coefficients. kappa/N/M are each a single linear equation in an inserted multiplier with a one-line solve; the c(D) perturbation is the only test here that deforms the actual mathematical input.

5_part3_polar_subtraction.support_filter_used: n<=QCHK-2, |l|<=20, D=4n-l^2>=-4 (excludes finite-YCAP-truncation noise in the deep-negative-D tail of 1/A; see note) -- this filter EXCLUDES an unresolved point at (n,l)=(4,-5), D=-9, where the remainder is exactly -324 and stays exactly -324 when YCAP is doubled (60->120, checked explicitly) -- so it is NOT window truncation noise, it is a genuine unexplained discrepancy outside D>=-4. The N=324/M=648 solution is therefore verified on D>=-4 only, not unconditionally.
5_part3_polar_subtraction.caveat: Truncated at QCHK=6 in q, YCAP=60 in y, to keep the invA recursion and A_{2,1}/Hhat construction well inside runtime budget. The comparison window (n<=QCHK-2, |l|<=20, D=4n-l^2>=-4) was chosen to avoid the top q-order (genuine truncation boundary of the invA recursion) AND to exclude a specific unresolved point at (n,l)=(4,-5), D=-9: there the remainder is exactly -324 and STAYS exactly -324 when YCAP is doubled to 120 (checked explicitly), so it is NOT a finite-window artifact -- it is a genuine, unexplained discrepancy outside the D>=-4 region this script actually verifies. The N=324 / M=648 solutions below are therefore reported as holding on D>=-4 only, not unconditionally; the D<-4 tail of the polar-subtraction identity was left unresolved (see could_not_do).

could_not_do: The D<-4 tail of the m=1 polar-subtraction identity (Delta*psi_1 - N*A_2,1 = 3E4A - M*Hhat) was NOT reconciled: at (n,l)=(4,-5), D=-9, the remainder is exactly -324 for N=324, independent of YCAP (checked at 60 and 120) -- a genuine unresolved discrepancy, not a truncation artifact. N=324, M=648 are reported as the unique solution on D>=-4 only.
